about_short_description.short_description: A Professional Development Platform Making Mentorship the New Norm!

product.name: Latte™ Admin
product.description: A control panel for program managers and ERGs to monitor user engagement and manage mentorship matchmaking within an organization.

product.name: User Management
product.description: A feature that allows quick addition of users, role assignment, and creation of mentorship matches with an overview of professional wellness across the organization.

product.name: Analytics & Reports
product.description: Tools to view and analyze company-wide and individual engagement with mentorship activities to inform decision-making.

product.name: Mobile Mentoring Platform
product.description: A mobile platform enabling users to schedule, conduct video mentoring sessions, access learning content, and receive notifications anytime and anywhere.

product.name: In-app Calendar & Scheduling
product.description: An integrated calendar and scheduling system that manages mentoring session logistics, including automatic handling of calendar syncing and session links.

product.name: Live Video Sessions
product.description: A feature that enables real-time video mentoring sessions within the platform without requiring external tools.
